description: Mac Excel text collation through the worksheet functions: the 16 function columns (SORT, SORTBY, UNIQUE, MATCH 0/1, VLOOKUP FALSE/TRUE, HLOOKUP FALSE, XLOOKUP, XMATCH, COUNTIF, SUMIF, SWITCH, FILTER, GROUPBY, DCOUNTA) against 8 representative pairs, plus a pairwise selection of further pairs, directions and data positions on one function per strength and addition rule. Every probe resolves to a single scalar. Range-based functions use setup cells; no setup cell is empty.
